label: SA-11(3)
title: Independent Verification of Assessment Plans and Evidence

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Require an independent agent satisfying {{ insert: param, sa-11.03_odp }} to verify the correct implementation of the developer security and privacy assessment plans and the evidence produced during testing and evaluation; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Verify that the independent agent is provided with sufficient information to complete the verification process or granted the authority to obtain such information.

guidance: Independent agents have the qualifications—including the expertise, skills, training, certifications, and experience—to verify the correct implementation of developer security and privacy assessment plans.

params.label: independence criteria
guidelines: independence criteria to be satisfied by an independent agent are defined;
